assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the exact original game map to edit. Create its final STATIC GROUND LAYER: keep the existing diagonal winding irregular earth path and every stepping stone ON that path exactly in place, with the same very uneven broad earth islands, varying path width, irregular grassy edge, pale sand-beige tones, original small natural interruptions and turns. This original irregular path is the PRIMARY invariant: do not straighten, tile, thin, simplify into a uniform strip or replace its stones with evenly spaced ellipses. Also preserve the calm green grass colors and broad faint green areas. REMOVE all independent environment props OUTSIDE THE PATH: both pink cherry trees and their cast shadows, all large boulders away from the path, all standalone blade tufts, bushes, flowers, petals and the entire pond with its shore stones, plants and water. Fill those removed areas ONLY with surrounding clean quiet green meadow ground. Keep no horizon, no UI, no characters, no text, no watermark, no border. Whole image is opaque 16:9 ground with ONLY meadow grass + original fixed irregular path and path stones. No new decoration anywhere.

Use case: stylized-concept. Image 1 is style, palette and viewpoint reference, especially its pond at the right edge. Create ONE COMPLETE stand-alone modular pond-cluster asset for that 2D game, including water, varied shore rocks and nearby grass as a SINGLE grouped design. High overhead orthographic oblique view 60-65 degrees above ground, see mainly tops, clean dark blue-green outline, 2-3 restrained cel shade colors, light from upper left. Organic asymmetric oval turquoise pond width about 1.8 times height. Irregular rim of grey-sage rocks of several sizes, NOT evenly spaced pebbles in a circle: a few larger rocks on upper left and lower right, small joined stones between them. Three sparse broad teal/lime grass tufts grow among shore rocks; one small green lily-pad pair on water. Match the original reference's concise clean commercial 2D mobile RPG art, NO realism or pixel art, no glossy 3D. Show the entire pond and entire shore with modest transparent padding, nothing cropped. Real alpha transparency outside the grouped pond/rock/grass silhouette; no big surrounding square or oval of grass, no ground plane or detached objects, no drop shadow or glow, no surrounding scenery or extra unrelated props. No text, watermark or UI. This one asset must move as a complete pond with its own shore.
